{{Top}}
[[File:CommUnit.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Comm unit]]
{{Quote|No doubt General Solo was literally grafted to the shuttle's comm unit.|Mon Mothma|<ref name="Deposition">{{WEGCite|story=The Deposition of General Solo|book=The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook}}</ref>}}
A '''comm unit''', also known as a '''comm system''', was any onboard [[Starship/Legends|starship]] communications device used to transmit and receive signals to and from outside sources. Handheld comm units also existed.

Most starships and vehicles had comm units installed in them.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
